local.name: きあいだめ
local.text: 次の自分の番、自分が使う「こうそくいどう」のダメージは「40」になる。

en.name: Focus
en.text: During your next turn, this card's Agility attack does 40 damage.

local.name: こうそくいどう
local.text: コインを1回投げ、「おもて」なら、次の相手の番、自分はワザによるダメージや効果を受けない。

en.name: Agility
en.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this card takes no damage or other effects from attacks during your opponent's next turn.
